name: mobbin
description: Mobbin MCP server and skills for finding real-world app screens, flows, and website sections while designing and building UI.

interface.longDescription: Where teams and agents find designs that work. Mobbin is a library of real app screens, user flows, and website sections from leading mobile apps, web apps, and websites. This plugin lets designers and developers look up how real products handle a screen or flow while they design and build UI, then use those references to redesign a screen, compare patterns, or pick a direction. Skills cover searching Mobbin well, redesigning a screen grounded in real examples, and getting started with Mobbin. Signing in with a Mobbin account is required. Results are limited to the apps and websites in the Mobbin library.
defaultPrompt: Find onboarding flows from top fintech apps on Mobbin.
Redesign this settings screen using real apps on Mobbin as reference.
